hard_frame.openingRule: Continue from first_frame as literal State #0; never replay completed action.
hard_frame.lastFrameRule: When last_frame exists, land on it at the exact end.

reference.rule: Bind each reference to explicit identity/product/place/motion/audio purpose.

video_edit.rule: State exactly what changes and what remains unchanged.

video_extend.rule: State direction and continue audiovisual state without replay.

productionRules: Never mix first_frame/last_frame with reference_xx/file/link in one request.
If a reference video is supplied, preflight input-video + requested output <=30 seconds.
Use Image 1 / Video 1 / Audio 1 labels according to separate media-type order.
Use prompt_extend only as provider prompt rewrite; canonical SmartAIHub state remains authoritative.
